_note: Ranges verified Oct 30, 2026 against Steam's Workshop API (ISteamRemoteStorage/GetPublishedFileDetails): min_build is now anchored to each Workshop page's creation date — a mod cannot be compatible with a build dated before it existed. 11 mins were corrected (Death Helper/Pet Finder Jun 2015->Dec 2015, Platforms Anywhere Jun 2015->Oct 2016, Platforms Plus Jun 2016->Jul 2016, Advanced Rafts Jun 2016->Aug 2016, eco's RP Decor Jun 2016->Aug 2016, eco's Garden Decor Jun 2016->March 2017, eco's Stable Structures Jun 2017->Jul 2017, Stack Me More Jun 2016->Oct 2017 for the moved page 1184731864, Stacks Evolved Jun 2017->Dec 2017, Super Structures Jul 2019->Feb 2020 — Jul 2019 was the S+ release it forked from, not this page's release). Max_build remains best-effort: a max past a mod's last update is an unverified tail, not proof it stops working, and S+'s Jul 2019 max is a fork/switch recommendation, not a hard limit. Coverage consequence, stated honestly: Jun-Sep 2015 builds now have 0 compatible mods and Oct-Nov 2015 have 1 (Advanced Architecture only) — ARK Workshop modding did not exist at the Jun 2015 launch, the earliest mod here was created Oct 2015. A Workshop download is always the latest cooked version, not the era version, so even a corrected range is not a guarantee that the download works on that old build.

mods.name: Death Helper
mods.description: Marks your death spot and helps you recover your corpse and items after you die. Clean and stackable, does not touch core files.

mods.name: Pet Finder
mods.description: Track down lost tames with an on-screen finder — points you at your dinos instead of wandering the map.

mods.name: Platforms Anywhere
mods.description: Build structures on platform saddles and rafts almost anywhere — foundations snap to dino platforms instead of being blocked.

mods.name: Advanced Architecture Mod
mods.description: Early building mod: foundations that flatten tricky spots, bridges, drawbridges, castle walls and battlements. In use from Oct 2015 onward.

mods.name: Structures Plus (S+)
mods.description: Stackable foundations, flush ceilings, crop plots that snap to foundations, sloped walls that snap under ceilings, and more. The classic 2016-2019 building mod.

mods.name: Platforms Plus
mods.description: Tree platforms with snap points for perimeter walls, extending ceilings, ladders, ramps and catwalks. Later folded into Structures Plus.

mods.name: Pillars Plus
mods.description: Fully adjustable pillars: straight, round and sloped, in wood, stone and metal. Later folded into Structures Plus.

mods.name: Reusable Plus
mods.description: Reusable versions of common tools: bola, flare gun, grappling hook, parachute and more — use them over and over instead of re-crafting.

mods.name: Stack Me More
mods.description: Reduced-weight resources with much higher stack sizes. This is the moved/updated Stack Me More page — the original 680481868 page points here.

mods.name: Annunaki Genesis
mods.description: Overhaul with new creatures, bosses and tiers on top of vanilla ARK. The 2016-era version — later Annunaki releases target newer game builds.

mods.name: Ark Steampunk Mod
mods.description: Steampunk-themed structures and gear: gears, whirs and clanks for a different-looking base. In use on 2016 servers.

mods.name: Advanced Rafts
mods.description: Advanced rafts, sails and more for ship building, with selectable third-person camera zoom and cargo holds.

mods.name: Castles, Keeps, and Forts (Legacy)
mods.description: Over 100 medieval building options: castles, forts, keeps and more. This is the Legacy version — use the Remastered version on current game builds instead.

mods.name: eco's RP Decor
mods.description: Decorative furniture and tons of other items for roleplay bases. 100% stackable, items can be picked up.

mods.name: eco's Garden Decor
mods.description: Fountains, topiary, indoor/outdoor lighting, fences and planters for your garden. 100% stackable.

mods.name: eco's Stable Structures
mods.description: Rustic structures, old-west decor and storage for stables, ranches, barns and western towns. 100% stackable.

mods.name: eco's Camping
mods.description: Decorative items for a camping setup. 100% stackable, items can be picked up.

mods.name: Classic Flyers
mods.description: Brings back pre-nerf flyers: vanilla flyer species get their old stats back, including levelling speed again. Only makes sense on builds after the Mar 2017 flyer nerf.

mods.name: Ultra Stacks
mods.description: Stacking mod, final version 2.21 (Aug 22, 2020), no longer updated as of Jun 5, 2021 — use a newer stacking mod on later builds.

mods.name: Stacks Evolved
mods.description: Balanced stacks without edited weights — bigger stacks for low/normal-rate play, without the weight changes of other stacking mods.

mods.name: Death Recovery Mod
mods.description: Alternative death-recovery mod from the 2016 era: recover items and folders after you die. Alternative to Death Helper.

mods.name: Awesome SpyGlass!
mods.description: Like a regular SpyGlass, except awesomer: shows stats for dinos, players, structures, eggs, loot and supply drops, with player-customisable options.

mods.name: Ark Eternal (Live Version)
mods.description: Big overhaul: new creatures, tiers and systems. NOTE: Ark Eternal does NOT support singleplayer — server play only, and it is a heavy overhaul, not a QoL mod.

mods.name: Simple Spawners
mods.description: Spawn creatures, harvestable resources, loot crates or nests anywhere. Clean and stackable — make your own biomes.

mods.name: Additional Creatures 2: Wild Ark
mods.description: Adds new wild creatures to the ARK. A content mod, not a QoL mod — check its own page for its creature list and load-order notes.

mods.name: Dino Storage v2
mods.description: Store dinos in soul balls / terminals: clean and stackable, no game content remapped or altered, works with modded dinos too.

mods.name: Super Structures
mods.description: Fork of Structures Plus from its July 11, 2019 release — everything S+ had at that time, maintained after S+ stopped. Use this instead of S+ on 2019+ builds.
